Failure-physics connection: Abrasion-erosion in gravel-laden flow creates localized wear hotspots; the mechanism mitigates this by shifting material to high-impact zones, maintaining uniform thickness.

Governing relation: Wear rate ∝ (particle kinetic energy × impact frequency) / material hardness.
